title: Dock Inspection
summary: Sector review: import, set up factors, audit missing data and compute a change score.
hints: Import with `read_csv()`, then `survey$group <- factor(survey$group, levels = c("Control", "Mindfulness"))`.
`colSums(is.na(survey))` counts missing values in every column; `sum(complete.cases(survey))` counts rows with nothing missing.
A change score is post minus pre: `survey$change <- survey$anxiety_post - survey$anxiety_pre`.
